{{Quote|The planet sits in the Borderland Regions, and it was the scene of some fierce fighting between New Republic and Imperial forces.|[[Gottu]]|<ref name="GaHV" />}}
The '''Battle of Jendorn''' was a battle of the [[Thrawn campaign]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] captured the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Jendorn]].

==The battle==
In [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]], the [[Trans-Hydian/Legends|Borderland Regions]] planet Jendorn was the site of a battle between forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. The Empire won and subsequently occupied the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bruzion]], where they set up a [[Prison/Legends|prison]] compound and held six downed [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]].<ref name="GaHV" />

==Aftermath==
[[Gottu]] and [[Idow]] of the [[Katarn Commandos|Page's Commandos]] were inserted by the New Republic into Bruzion and [[Mission to Jendorn|rescued]] the six pilots.<ref name="GaHV" />
